description: This file defines the ShapeMap class within the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for managing shape definitions used in API modeling and request/response serialization.

classes.name: ShapeMap
classes.description: A class that builds and resolves shape references based on shape definitions, used for modeling AWS API data structures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ShapeMap with an associative array of shape definitions.

methods.name: getShapeNames
methods.description: Returns an array of shape names defined in the shape map.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a shape reference to a Shape object, throwing an exception if the shape is not found.
